en.name: iMileMaster
en.short_description: Record drives by GPS and export an IRS-rated mileage log as PDF or CSV
en.subtitle: GPS mileage log for taxes
en.promotional_text: Records the distance you actually drove, rates it with the IRS figure for that tax year, and exports a PDF and CSV log. No account, nothing uploaded.
en.description:
MileMaster records the miles you drive and turns them into a mileage log you can file.

RECORDING A DRIVE
Start a drive and MileMaster follows your GPS position, adding up the distance between fixes as you go. It throws away readings that are too inaccurate, too small to be real movement, or too fast to be plausible, so the total reflects the road rather than GPS noise. When you stop, you pick what the drive was for and it is saved. Recording runs while the app is open: MileMaster does not track you in the background and does not detect drives by itself.

ADDING A TRIP BY HAND
Any drive can be entered or corrected manually. Type the miles directly, or give a start and end odometer reading and let the app take the difference. Each trip carries a date, a from and to label, a purpose and notes. Trips can be edited or swiped away later.

DEDUCTIONS
Business, medical and charity miles are rated with the IRS figures published for the tax year each trip falls in, and the app names the notice each rate came from. Personal miles are logged but not counted. You can override any year's rates and reset them again. This build ships the published rates for 2023, 2024 and 2025; for a later year it applies the most recent rate it has and tells you on screen that it is doing so. MileMaster is a record-keeping tool and not tax advice.

YOUR LOG
The dashboard totals your miles and deduction for the month, the year, or all time. Stats breaks the last week into a bar chart and splits your miles by purpose. Export hands a PDF report and a CSV of the same trips to the share sheet.

PRIVACY
Trips are stored in a database on this device and are never uploaded. There is no account, no sign-in and no server. The start and end address labels come from the operating system's own geocoder, and where that is unavailable the trip simply keeps its coordinates. There are no ads and nothing to buy.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
MileMaster records the miles you drive and turns them into a mileage log you can file.

Intended audience:
GPS mileage log for taxes

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- device location services (on-device)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (ar, de, en, es, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
